Episode 3 of Punch Punch Forever! by speedoru
Watch prev. episodes here  ➤  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8ndBoc6R8_A&list=PLsE71Ou1VsHRPMVCCC9Qf9nqQIwgb4wfb

Emperor Koro commissions the iconic Demon Wrestling Federation tag team twin duo, "The Nabe Brothers", to compete in his Infinite Tournament and break Mama's legs!
